glossary.dataset: A table is analysable data that KPubData creates from source datasets and manages as one unit. Each refresh adds a new snapshot.
glossary.build: The job that collects and processes data from the sources and settings you chose.
glossary.run: One recorded execution that creates or refreshes a table and produces a snapshot. A table can have many runs.
glossary.buildSpec: The portable execution spec telling KPubData Builder which sources to fetch and how to process them.
glossary.provider: An external data source or API that KPubData Builder can connect to.
glossary.credential: Authentication such as an API key, needed to fetch data from a provider.
glossary.preview: A look at part of the data and its validation results before you create or refresh a table.
glossary.bronze: The stage that keeps collected data as close to the original as possible.
glossary.silver: The stage where bronze data is cleaned and standardized for analysis and quality checks.
glossary.gold: The final stage, shaped for a particular use.
glossary.quality: The results of the data quality rules KPubData Builder actually evaluated.
glossary.schemaDrift: A change in data structure — columns added, removed or retyped — compared with before.
glossary.evidence: The KPubData Builder table, run and quality facts an Ask KPubData answer or report is based on.
glossary.context: The table, run, source and stage scope Ask KPubData uses to interpret your question.
glossary.generatedSql: The query SQL Ask KPubData generated from the silver or gold schema you selected.
glossary.artifact: Snapshot files are the data files and other outputs a run saves in its snapshot.
glossary.manifest: The metadata record of a run and the snapshot files it produced.
glossary.readiness: KPubData Builder's check of the conditions that must hold before publishing.

run_failed.message: The run ended with an error, so there is nothing to publish.
run_failed.action: Open the run to see what failed, fix it and run it again.

run_cancelled.message: The run was cancelled before it finished.
run_cancelled.action: Run the table again, then publish the new run.

gold_unavailable.message: The run has no successful Gold output to publish.
gold_unavailable.action: Open the run and check its Gold stage; run it again if it did not complete.

artifact_missing.message: A Gold file the run's manifest lists is missing on KPubData Builder.
artifact_missing.action: Check the run's snapshot files, then run the table again to rebuild them.

artifact_invalid.message: A Gold file the run's manifest lists could not be resolved safely, so KPubData Builder refuses to publish it.
artifact_invalid.action: Check the run's snapshot files, then run the table again to rebuild them.

license_missing.message: The table's spec declares no licence, and a table cannot be published without one.
license_missing.action: Edit the spec, declare the licence and run the table again.

pii_allow_with_publish.message: The spec's PII policy is "allow", and a spec that lets personal data through cannot be published.
pii_allow_with_publish.action: Edit the spec, choose a PII policy that masks or drops personal data, and run the table again.

credential_unavailable.message: No publish credential is available for this target.
credential_unavailable.action: Ask a KPubData Builder operator to configure one, or store your own publish credential.

credential_required.message: This deployment publishes only with your own publish credential.
credential_required.action: Follow the credential guidance below, then check again.

local_publish_root_unconfigured.message: The local publish target has no publish root configured on KPubData Builder.
local_publish_root_unconfigured.action: Ask a KPubData Builder operator to set KPUBDATA_BUILDER_LOCAL_PUBLISH_ROOT.

destination_outside_publish_root.message: The local destination lies outside KPubData Builder's publish root.
destination_outside_publish_root.action: Choose a destination inside the publish root.

kaggle_metadata_missing.message: The run has no Kaggle packaging (`dataset-metadata.json`) to publish.
kaggle_metadata_missing.action: This is a Kaggle packaging problem: check the table's Kaggle export and run it again.

kaggle_metadata_ambiguous.message: The run has more than one Kaggle packaging, so KPubData Builder cannot tell which to publish.
kaggle_metadata_ambiguous.action: This is a Kaggle packaging problem: keep one Kaggle export in the spec and run the table again.

kaggle_metadata_unreadable.message: The run's `dataset-metadata.json` cannot be read or has no id.
kaggle_metadata_unreadable.action: This is a Kaggle packaging problem: check the table's Kaggle export and run it again.

kaggle_destination_mismatch.message: The Kaggle packaging's `id` differs from the destination.
kaggle_destination_mismatch.action: Publish to the `id` the packaging names, or change the Kaggle export and run the table again.

redistribution_forbidden.message: A source's terms forbid redistribution, so this table cannot be published anywhere.
redistribution_forbidden.action: Nothing on this page can change that. Remove the source, or use the data inside KPubData Builder only.

redistribution_unknown.message: A source's terms are not known, and unknown terms are not permission to publish publicly.
redistribution_unknown.action: Publish privately (keep the private setting on), or wait until the source's terms are declared.

non_commercial_unconfirmed.message: A source allows non-commercial use only, and you have not confirmed that this publish is for that use.
non_commercial_unconfirmed.action: Tick "I agree to the non-commercial terms" below, then publish.

non_commercial_marker_missing.message: A public publish of non-commercial data needs a non-commercial licence on the table (for example cc-by-nc-4.0).
non_commercial_marker_missing.action: Publish privately, or edit the spec to declare a non-commercial licence and run the table again.

destination_public.message: The source terms allow only a private publish, but the destination already exists and is public. Publishing does not change its visibility.
destination_public.action: Choose a new or private destination.

destination_visibility_unknown.message: The source terms allow only a private publish, and KPubData Builder could not read whether the destination is public.
destination_visibility_unknown.action: Check that the destination exists and your token can read it, or choose a new destination, then try again.

card_missing.message: The run's Gold output has no data card (`card.json`): it was built before KPubData Builder wrote cards.
card_missing.action: Run the table again; the new run's Gold output carries its card. Then publish that run.

card_incomplete.message: A required section of the run's data card is empty (provenance, processing or personal information).
card_incomplete.action: KPubData Builder's message below names the empty section. Fill in what it comes from in the spec (for example the licence or source URL) and run the table again.

unknown.message: KPubData Builder reported a blocker Studio does not know: {{code}}.
unknown.action: Read KPubData Builder's message below and resolve it, then check again.

redistribution.title: Redistribution terms

explain.non_commercial: A source allows non-commercial use only. Publishing needs your confirmation, and a public publish also needs a non-commercial licence on the table.
explain.unknown: A source's terms are not known. KPubData Builder publishes this table only privately, to a destination that is not already public.
explain.forbidden: A source's terms forbid redistribution. KPubData Builder does not publish this table.

redistribution.confirmLabel: I agree to the non-commercial terms
redistribution.confirmHint: I confirm that this table is published for non-commercial use only, as its sources' terms require. KPubData Builder records this confirmation with the publish.
redistribution.unknownPublicNote: A source's terms are unknown, so KPubData Builder refuses a public publish. Keep the private setting on.
redistribution.nonCommercialPublicNote: A public publish of non-commercial data also needs a non-commercial licence (for example cc-by-nc-4.0) on the table, or KPubData Builder refuses it.

card.title: Data card to be published
card.note: The data card (card.json) KPubData Builder wrote for each Gold output. Publishing uploads it as the README.
card.demo: Demo mode has no real run, so there is no data card to show.
card.listError: Could not load the data card. KPubData Builder still checks it in publish readiness.

none.title: This run has no data card
none.desc: It was built before KPubData Builder wrote cards. Run the table again; the new run's Gold output carries its card.

refused.redistribution_forbidden: The source terms forbid redistribution, so KPubData Builder does not hand out the card file.
refused.declared_pii_withheld: KPubData Builder withholds this file because of declared personal information columns.
refused.pii_declaration_unavailable: KPubData Builder withholds this file because the source's personal information declaration could not be read.

card.licenceMismatchNote: The licence in this run's spec differs from the one the KPubData catalogue declares for this source. The card records both. Check which is right before publishing.
card.verbatimNote: Each sentence is KPubData Builder's own text, which the published README carries as is.

report.withContact: If it keeps happening, report it with this error ID.
report.withoutContact: If it keeps happening, give this error ID to your administrator.

dashboard-builds.copy: Review recent runs and their progress, and open run details when you need more.

dashboard-quality.copy: Review recent quality warnings and follow up where needed.

start-actions.title: Start here
start-actions.copy: Use Discover to find data in the catalog, or Add Data to bring in an API, file or URL yourself.

workflow.title: How data gets made
workflow.copy: Find data, set up the import, check and validate the real rows in preview, then create the table. After that you can review quality results and use the data.

schemas.uploadIdFormat: The upload_id format is not valid.

schemas.sourcesRequired: At least one source is required.
schemas.exportsRequired: Select at least one export format.

mock.noSpecSnapshot: Mock mode does not simulate a BuildSpec snapshot. Check it in real-integration mode.
mock.noRunEvents: Mock mode does not simulate structured run events. Check them in real-integration mode.

cancel.confirm: Cancel run {{id}}? A running refresh stops at its next safe stage boundary; what it has already written is kept. This cannot be undone.
cancel.accepted: Cancellation requested — waiting for KPubData Builder to report the new status.
cancel.cancellingHint: KPubData Builder stops the run at its next safe stage boundary.

refused.forbidden: You cannot cancel this run: it is not yours.
refused.notFound: KPubData Builder no longer has this run in its job registry, so it cannot be cancelled.
refused.finished: This run can no longer be cancelled: it has already finished.

split.title: Split algorithm
split.unfamiliar: Studio does not know this algorithm; it is shown as KPubData Builder recorded it.

split.key: Key split — membership follows the key, not an algorithm.

split.differs: The previous run {{run}} split with {{algorithm}}. The split methods differ, so train/test membership may differ even with the same seed.

params.finiteOnly: Parameter JSON may only contain finite numbers and JSON values.
params.invalidJson: The parameters are not valid JSON. Check the format.

oidc.issuerInvalid: VITE_OIDC_ISSUER is not a valid format: {{issuer}}

versionCheck.contractMajor: The connected KPubData Builder speaks API contract {{api}}. This Studio reads the contract of {{min}}'s major version; with another major its screens cannot read Builder's answers.

sql.title: SQL Workspace
sql.desc: You run the query. Ask KPubData may suggest SQL but never runs it.
sql.needRun: This table has no run to query.
sql.needSource: This run has several sources — choose the one to query.
sql.oneTable: One table per query. Joining tables comes with KPubData Builder multi-table SQL.
sql.loadError: Could not load the tables or their runs.
sql.saveLater: Saving an analysis waits for server storage in KPubData Builder; a browser-only save would be lost on another device.

errors.unknown: The query failed for an unknown reason.

sql.currentNote: "Current" is pinned when the query starts; a refresh committed while it runs does not change what it reads.

coverage.complete: Snapshot {{snapshot}}: every row the source reported was fetched.
coverage.partial: Snapshot {{snapshot}}: partial — fewer rows were fetched than the source reported.
coverage.unknown: Snapshot {{snapshot}}: coverage unknown — nothing records it as complete.

sql.tableInFrom: KPubData Builder reads the selected table only as `dataset`. Before running, use `FROM dataset` instead of {{names}}.
sql.explorerFallback: The table explorer and snapshot pinning need a KPubData Builder with a warehouse. Here you query a run's table directly.

explorer.title: Table explorer
explorer.hint: Table → Source → Column. Picking a source binds `dataset` to it; picking a column inserts it at the editor's cursor. Nothing runs.

demoWarehouse.needsBuilder: The demo has no KPubData Builder, so it does not run queries, aggregates, exports or saved analyses. Connect a Builder to run them.
demoWarehouse.tableNotFound: The demo has no table named {{name}}.
demoWarehouse.snapshotNotFound: The demo has no committed snapshot of {{name}} with that id.

redistribution_forbidden.title: This data may not be redistributed, so its results cannot be shown
redistribution_forbidden.reason: The source's terms forbid redistribution, so this data does not leave Builder through a query, preview or export. The query is not wrong; running it again gives the same answer.
redistribution_forbidden.next: Check the source's terms of use, or use other data that may be redistributed.

declared_pii_withheld.title: Declared personal-data columns cannot be shown unmasked
declared_pii_withheld.reason: It holds columns the source declares as personal data, unmasked, so Builder did not let it out.
declared_pii_withheld.next: Read the Gold stage instead: Gold serves declared personal data masked.

pii_declaration_unavailable.title: The personal-data declaration could not be checked, so this was blocked to be safe
pii_declaration_unavailable.reason: Builder could not read the source's personal-data declaration, so it does not know which columns are personal and refused the Silver or Bronze read.
pii_declaration_unavailable.next: Try again later, or read the Gold stage, which is not affected.

admin.title: Administration
admin.desc: The policy in force and every owner's runs — metadata only, never a credential or a result.
admin.mock: Administration needs a real KPubData Builder; mock mode has no administrator.
admin.forbiddenBody: KPubData Builder refused this request (403). The menu hides this page, but the Builder is what blocks it.
admin.enforceOwnership: Each user sees only their own runs and tables.
admin.publishFallback: Publishing may fall back to the server's publish credential when a user has none.
admin.runsNote: Every owner's runs, metadata only. An owner is an irreversible hash, not an identity.
admin.cardForbidden: KPubData Builder refused this request (403); only an administrator can see it.
admin.policyUnsupported: This KPubData Builder has no GET /admin/config (404): it predates the admin API, or Studio is pointed at the wrong path. This is not an empty policy.
admin.runsUnsupported: This KPubData Builder has no GET /admin/runs (404): it predates the admin API, or Studio is pointed at the wrong path. This is not an empty run list.
admin.runsEmpty: KPubData Builder has recorded no runs yet.
admin.runsShownCapped: Showing the latest {{n}} runs. There may be more — KPubData Builder does not report a total.
admin.runsAtMax: {{max}} is the most that can be shown at once.
admin.runsAtMaxOfTotal: {{max}} is the most that can be shown at once — {{left}} older runs are not shown.

users.title: Users and sign-up approval
users.note: Everyone who has signed in through OIDC, from KPubData Builder's sign-up ledger. A user is an irreversible hash and a display name — no credential or token is kept or shown.
users.unsupported: This KPubData Builder has no sign-up ledger (it needs contract 1.54 or later).
users.empty: No OIDC user has signed in yet. A deployment without OIDC has no sign-ups to approve.
users.confirmApprove: Approve {{name}}? They can build and query from their next request.
users.confirmReject: Reject {{name}}? KPubData Builder refuses their requests from then on, even if an allowlist admits them.
users.decisionForbidden: KPubData Builder refused this decision (403). Only an administrator can approve or reject a sign-up.
users.decisionNotFound: KPubData Builder has no user {{name}} (404). The list may be out of date.

analyses.title: Saved Analyses
analyses.desc: SQL kept with the snapshot it read, so running it again reads the same input after a refresh.
analyses.noWarehouse: Saving analyses needs a KPubData Builder with a warehouse; this deployment has none, so SQL Workspace queries runs directly and cannot save.
analyses.emptyDesc: Run a query in SQL Workspace and save it with a name.
analyses.confirmDelete: Delete "{{name}}"? Its snapshot is no longer kept for it.
analyses.saved: Saved "{{name}}" with the snapshot it read.
analyses.migrationBody: Builder SQL changed after this analysis was saved, so it is not run again as it is. Open it in SQL Workspace, check the SQL, and save it as a new analysis.
analyses.migrationWorkspace: This analysis was saved before Builder SQL changed. Check the SQL below and save it as a new analysis; the saved one is kept as it is.

dataTable.truncated: Truncated — cut at the limit. Unless the query ordered it, this is not the "top N"
dataTable.pinned: Snapshot {{snapshot}} pinned — the next pages read the same snapshot

masked.explanation: The source declares this column as personal data, so Builder masked it: text values arrive as [masked], any other type as empty (null).
masked.cellToken: Builder masked this value: it is declared personal data.
masked.cellNull: A masked column. A non-text value becomes empty (null) when masked, so it cannot be told apart from a value that was empty to begin with.

charts.title: Chart
charts.additive: This column may be added up (needed for a sum)
charts.noMeasure: No column can be drawn as a number — identifier (code) columns are text, not measures.
charts.missingCount: {{count}} with no value — drawn as gaps, not 0

scope.topN: Top {{returned}} by {{order}} — of {{total}} groups. Aggregated over every row
scope.truncated: Based on the {{count}} rows returned — a cut result: not the whole, not the top N, not a sample

export.title: Export the result
export.note: KPubData Builder writes the file — it pins the snapshot, checks the source's terms and PII policy, and refuses a result over the row or size limit instead of cutting it. Studio never builds a result file itself.
export.bomNote: A BOM only makes Excel read UTF-8. It does not stop leading zeros, large integers or dates from being converted. Cells that start like a formula get a leading ' and are counted.
export.coverageUnknown: Fetch coverage: not recorded (unknown, not complete)
export.derived: A result derived by your query
export.termsUnknown: not confirmed ({{status}}) — check the source before redistributing

refused.license: The source's licence forbids changes (e.g. KOGL type 3 or 4), so it cannot be exported. Nothing was kept.
refused.pii: Refused: values the PII policy does not let out: {{findings}}. Nothing was kept.
refused.limit: Refused: over the row or size limit. Results are not cut, so nothing was kept — narrow the query or raise the limit.
refused.redistribution: The source's terms forbid redistribution, so it cannot be exported. Nothing was kept — check the source's terms, or use data that may be redistributed.
refused.declaredPii: Refused: it holds declared personal-data columns ({{columns}}) unmasked. Nothing was kept — leave those columns out or read Gold.
refused.declaredPiiUnnamed: Refused: it holds declared personal-data columns unmasked. Nothing was kept — leave those columns out or read Gold.
refused.piiDeclarationUnavailable: Refused to be safe: the personal-data declaration of {{dataset}} could not be checked. Nothing was kept — try again later.
refused.piiDeclarationUnavailableUnnamed: Refused to be safe: the source's personal-data declaration could not be checked. Nothing was kept — try again later.

history.title: My exports
history.note: Exports KPubData Builder still keeps for you, newest first. Builder deletes each one when it expires (24 hours after it was made); download or delete it before then.
history.confirmDelete: Delete the export of {{table}} ({{id}})? Builder deletes its file too; this cannot be undone.
history.gone: That export is no longer in KPubData Builder, so it was removed from the list.

reason.expired: Expired: Builder has deleted its file, so it can no longer be downloaded. Export the query again.
reason.failed: Failed: Builder did not finish this export, so there is no file. Export the query again.
reason.cancelled: Cancelled: the export was stopped before it finished, so there is no file.
reason.pending: Builder is still writing this export; refresh to see when it is ready.

refused.unavailable: Builder's file for this export is missing or no longer matches its digest, so it was not sent. Export the query again.

statusState.missing: KPubData Builder did not provide this value
statusState.axesMissing: Table status: not provided by KPubData Builder

runView.noWarehouse: This deployment has no warehouse, so the table is shown by run.

errors.table: Could not load the table's snapshots
errors.runs: Could not load the run history.

tableDetail.notCommittedDesc: This source table has not been committed yet. It shows here once a refresh finishes.
tableDetail.schemaNote: {{count}} columns in this snapshot — types, display names and units as KPubData Builder sent them.
tableDetail.snapshotsNote: This source table's snapshots, newest first. A past snapshot is chosen only here.

licence.source: As declared in the BuildSpec of run {{run}}.
licence.undeclared: Unknown — not declared in the BuildSpec
licence.nameUndeclared: Unknown — the licence name is not declared
licence.attributionRequired: Required for KOGL but not declared

unavailable.noRun: Unknown — no run produced this table.
unavailable.legacy: Unknown — this run has no BuildSpec snapshot.
unavailable.demo: Unknown — the demo has no terms of use. Connect KPubData Builder to see them.
unavailable.error: Unknown — could not read the BuildSpec: {{message}}

profile.title: Column profile
profile.loading: KPubData Builder is reading every row of this snapshot to profile its columns. This can take up to 60 seconds.
profile.note: Exact, over every row. NaN and infinite values are counted apart and left out of ranges. A range over fewer than {{min}} values is withheld. “Not detected” is not a guarantee — only value patterns and column names are checked.
profile.noteTrimmed: Counts are exact, over every row. A range is the minimum and maximum after the {{count}} lowest and the {{count}} highest values are left out, so that one record's extreme is not disclosed. NaN and infinite values are counted apart and left out of ranges. A range over fewer than {{min}} values is withheld. “Not detected” is not a guarantee — only value patterns and column names are checked.
profile.withheldNote: Columns suspected of holding personal data ({{count}}) show only their name, types and sensitivity.
profile.withheld: Statistics withheld: suspected personal data. No value is shown.

sensitivity.uncheckedValues: values not checked (a type that can hold text)

range.excluded: NaN or infinite values left out: {{count}}
range.trimmed: Lowest and highest {{count}} values left out
range.trimmedUnknown: Lowest and highest values left out

profile.error: Could not load the column profile
profile.mismatch: Builder sent the profile of {{received}} instead of the requested snapshot {{requested}}, so it is not shown.

query_timeout.title: Profiling timed out
query_timeout.body: KPubData Builder limits profiling to 60 seconds. It remembers the timeout for this snapshot for 5 minutes, and until then answers the same request at once without profiling again.
query_timeout.next: Retry after {{time}}, or aggregate only the columns you need in SQL.

query_busy.title: KPubData Builder has no free query slot
query_busy.body: Other queries are using every slot. Retry in a moment.

snapshot_unavailable.title: This snapshot cannot be read
snapshot_unavailable.body: KPubData Builder could not read this snapshot's file. Choose another snapshot in the Snapshots tab.

redistribution_forbidden.title: The source terms forbid redistribution
redistribution_forbidden.body: The source's terms of use forbid its data leaving KPubData Builder, column statistics included.

pii_declaration_unavailable.title: The source's personal data declaration could not be read
pii_declaration_unavailable.body: KPubData Builder could not read the source's kpubdata personal data declaration, so it refused rather than risk it. Retry in a moment, and tell the Builder operator if it persists.

qualityTrend.title: Quality trend across runs
qualityTrend.description: PASS/WARN/FAIL per run, newest first, as Builder recorded it. A run with no evaluated checks reads N/A.
qualityTrend.error: Failed to load the quality history
qualityTrend.emptyDescription: Builder has no run with quality results for this table. Nothing is estimated in its place.
qualityTrend.noRateYet: No run in this history has an evaluated pass rate yet.
qualityTrend.sparklineLabel: Pass rate across {{runs}} runs, oldest to newest; {{rated}} with a rate
qualityTrend.sparklineGaps: Gaps are runs with no evaluated checks ({{gaps}}).

specRevisions.title: Change history
specRevisions.description: Every save of this spec is kept by KPubData Builder as a new revision. Builder records who saved it and when; credentials are never stored.
specRevisions.noDocId: This table ID cannot hold a change history (it is empty, longer than 200 characters, or contains '/').

base.error: Could not check the latest revision: {{message}}
base.none: No revision has been saved yet. The first save becomes revision 1.

specRevisions.cannotSave: The form has an error, so this spec cannot be saved yet. Fix it, then save.

notice.reverted: Reverted to the content of revision {{from}} as revision {{revision}}, and loaded it into the form.
notice.loaded: Loaded revision {{revision}} into the form. The next save builds on it.

pending.title: Your sign-up is waiting for approval
pending.desc: You are signed in, but KPubData Builder shows nothing to this account until an administrator approves it. That is why no screen can load data yet.
pending.next: Ask your administrator to approve the account, then choose Check again.

rejected.title: Your sign-up was rejected
rejected.desc: An administrator rejected this account's sign-up, so KPubData Builder refuses every request from it.
rejected.next: If you think this is a mistake, contact your administrator.

sessionRefused.title: KPubData Builder does not accept this sign-in
sessionRefused.desc: You are still signed in, but KPubData Builder refuses the request even with a newly issued token. This is not an expired token; it is the account or the configuration.
sessionRefused.next: Check that your e-mail address is verified. If it still fails, give this reason to your administrator. Until then the screens do not resend their queries.
sessionRefused.nextEmail: The e-mail address of this account is not verified yet. Open the link in the verification mail from your sign-in provider, then press "Try again". Until then the screens do not resend their queries.
